review_scope: Twelve second-batch midpoint images opened individually. No full-video or box approval.

decisions.reason: Elevated warehouse but black editorial circles obscure apparent people/operators. Do not infer hidden persons. Other frames not examined.
Close eye-level portrait recording with text; not elevated distant CCTV.
Elevated factory with burning forklift and text in corner. Factory layout appears related to _XXq1kmmBYY: compare clips and group conservatively before splitting.
Elevated warehouse aisle, forklift and cargo, news banner and logo. Crop feasibility and relationship to other warehouse-collapse recordings unresolved.
Elevated loading dock with two visible pedestrians. Red pallet truck must not automatically become forklift class 1; fixed dock platform is not cargo.
Elevated monochrome warehouse with forklifts and loads; bottom-left branding may obstruct part of machine and needs crop review.
Ground-level handheld outdoor recording, blurred pillarbox areas and editorial branding; not desired CCTV framing.
Ground-level forklift demonstration with close operator; unsuitable for elevated expansion.
Elevated rack aisle and forklift, with branded lower border. Need inspect driver visibility and removable banner.
Close portrait of person addressing camera with subtitles; no CCTV view.
Eye-level forklift shot with large top/bottom panels and central text obscuring scene; not suitable midpoint.
Elevated indoor packing area, visible pedestrian and many boxes. Classify pallet-handling equipment carefully; no operator inferred in unoccupied equipment.
